correctness.rationale: For any p>2 and a,b>=0, Meyer 2026 Lemma 2.4 reduces all nontrivial plane sumset points to a parallelogram of edge lengths at most 2a,2b. The elementary midpoint-vector bound for one of its triangles is followed by the correctly directed p>2 Hanner norm inequality. The resulting homogeneous envelope is increasing separately in a,b. The orthogonal-coordinate pair u=(2^(1-1/p)a,2^(1-1/p)a), v=(2^(1-1/p)b,-2^(1-1/p)b) attains the proposed exact bound at the parallelogram center for every a,b including zero. CHECK.py confirms a rational p=4 identity and sample instances, not an infinite theorem.
